carpet.rule.cofDebugCommand.name: CoF Debug Tool
carpet.rule.cofDebugCommand.desc: Whether the /cofdebug diagnostic command is enabled; 0-4 = enabled and only usable by players whose permission level reaches that number
carpet.rule.waterCauldronFreezing.desc: Freezes a full water cauldron in a snow-capable biome when it is exposed to the sky and block light is below 10, dropping a product at the cauldron
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingProduct.desc: What a water cauldron produces and how many freeze events each item needs: ice = ice every time, packed_ice = one packed ice per 2, blue_ice = one blue ice per 3; the count resets after every item.
carpet.rule.waterBucketNotConsumed.desc: Using a water bucket in survival does not consume it
carpet.rule.waterBottleNotConsumed.desc: Using a water bottle to fill a cauldron in survival does not consume it
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingChance.desc: Freeze check frequency: 48 matches vanilla water freezing, smaller values freeze faster
carpet.rule.cauldronFreezingRequiresFull: When enabled only completely filled cauldrons freeze; disable to let water levels 1-3 freeze too
